description: Graph-native recognition of raw grounded PyBullet humanoid connection, morphology, opaque actuator and reset/pose/trial capability facts. Python only ingests these facts; no float, program, actuator selection, goal or reset choice crosses the boundary.

rules.name: ebi_recognize_connected_pybullet_humanoid_as_situated_body_and_world
rules.comment: A raw connected body observation plus real reset, pose-fixture and trial capabilities is sufficient for the graph to recognize a situated learning environment. The adapter supplies facts; this rule supplies the category.

rules.name: ebi_materialize_integer_motor_bootstrap_contract_from_raw_interface
rules.comment: The body boundary declares only integer actuator and measurement interface limits. The graph materializes a reusable contract; it intentionally contains no trial duration, axis, sign or preferred program.

rules.name: ebi_materialize_cartesian_measurement_projection_affordances
rules.comment: Every declared Cartesian axis/sign projection becomes an equally available graph affordance. The rule carries no preference over direction or frame.

rules.name: ebi_bind_observed_opaque_actuator_affordances_to_situated_body
rules.comment: Each body-side opaque actuator token is retained as an observed affordance. The rule does not rank, select or interpret any token.

rules.name: ebi_bind_observed_direct_effector_topology_to_situated_body
rules.comment: A mechanically observed direct link adjacency is retained as a local composition constraint. It does not make a motor program or select a command; receipt-grounded motor synthesis decides whether it is useful.

rules.name: ebi_materialize_pose_affordance_from_observed_fixture_capability
rules.comment: A declared pose fixture is a capability fact, not a hidden home pose. It permits an enabled situated pose-affordance but does not choose a fixture or reset scenario.

rules.name: ebi_activate_developmental_learning_from_grounded_physical_trial_capability
rules.comment: A recognized world that can execute grounded physical trials is an available developmental learning process. This is graph state inferred from an observed capability, not a Python start command.

rules.name: ebi_materialize_declared_initial_fixture_as_situated_reset_scenario
rules.comment: The configured initial fixture becomes one observed reset option. It is explicitly a situated option, not a canonical home configuration, and the graph remains free to select among later fixtures.

rules.name: ebi_open_situated_humanoid_development_episode_from_recognized_environment
rules.comment: Opening an episode is a graph consequence of recognized situated resources. It creates no goal or motor command; downstream developmental cognition owns those choices.

rules.name: ebi_mark_only_embodied_attachment_as_current
rules.comment: A sole mechanically attached world is current by cardinality. Multiple equal legacy ordinals remain intentionally unselected until a strictly newer attachment arrives.

rules.name: ebi_mark_strictly_newest_embodied_attachment_as_current
rules.comment: A strictly greater mechanically observed attachment ordinal makes the new connection current and retires older attachment authority. Equal legacy ordinals deliberately do not break ties.

rules.name: ebi_request_graph_selected_initial_situated_reset_for_active_learning
rules.comment: Once the existing developmental plan has selected a live capability, it may request a reset without specifying a scenario. The development seed's ordinary least-used-scenario rule performs the selection.
